description: In the HEC-RAS Muncie project, the boundary conditions file (Muncie.b04) is currently open in the text editor. This file defines the upstream and downstream boundary conditions for the unsteady flow simulation on the White River at Muncie, Indiana. The file contains an 'Upstream Flow Hydrograph' section with time-flow pairs. The current peak flow is 21000 cfs (appearing at hours 15-20). Your task is to increase all occurrences of the peak flow value 21000 to 25200 (a 20% increase) to simulate a larger flood scenario. After making the changes, save the file using Ctrl+S.
